- .claude/hooks/unattended_question_guard.py:152-169
  PROBLEM: The block counter state has no read-write atomicity. If Claude Code were to fire two Stop events in rapid succession (e.g., a blocked stop immediately followed by another stop attempt in the same continuation), a TOCTOU gap exists between read_blocks and write_blocks where both calls could see the same count. The worst case is one extra block beyond the cap.
  WHY: The reviewer says this is inherent to the hook model (no cross-invocation locking available). The 2-block cap plus fail-open above it already bounds the impact; no code change needed.
